csv_scope_of_work: The Village of Oak Park ( Village ) seeks proposals for an Oak Park Comprehensive Plan update. This Request for Proposal is to seek qualified planning consultants to prepare a revised and updated Comprehensive Plan for the Village of Oak Park, Illinois. The revised and updated Comprehensive Plan will serve as a guide in considering policy changes, land use planning, budget preparation, and capital improvement planning for the Village of Oak Park s future.
